components.name: Language Gates
components.description: Locale switcher on the band: dashed unloaded, solid loaded, signal yellow active.
components.css: .ds-gates{display:flex;gap:.5rem;margin:0;padding:1rem;list-style:none;background:var(--band)}.ds-gate{position:relative;display:grid;gap:.125rem;min-width:4.5rem;padding:.4rem .7rem .45rem;border:1.5px dashed var(--band-ink-2);border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:var(--band-ink);text-align:start;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out}.ds-loaded{border-style:solid}.ds-gate:hover{background:var(--band-hover)}.ds-gate:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--band-ink);outline-offset:2px}.ds-gate[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--signal);background:var(--signal);color:var(--on-signal)}.ds-gate[aria-pressed="true"]::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:.7rem;bottom:-.45rem;border:.45rem solid transparent;border-bottom:0;border-top-color:var(--signal)}.ds-code{font:600 .6875rem/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.8}.ds-name{font:600 .9375rem/1.3 var(--sans);white-space:nowrap}

components.name: Arrivals Board
components.description: Download log as a departures board on a band plate; new rows flash on arrival.
components.css: .ds-board{max-width:24rem;padding:1.25rem 1.375rem 1.125rem;border-radius:4px;background:var(--band);color:var(--band-ink)}.ds-board h2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.625rem;margin:0 0 .875rem;font:700 1.0625rem/1.3 var(--sans)}.ds-count{margin-inline-start:auto;padding:.125rem .5rem;border-radius:3px;background:var(--band-hover);font:600 .875rem/1.4 var(--mono)}.ds-board table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:.875rem/1.4 var(--mono);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-board th{padding:0 0 .375rem;color:var(--band-ink-2);font:600 .6875rem/1.2 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:start}.ds-board th+th,.ds-board td+td{text-align:end;padding-inline-start:.75rem}.ds-board td{padding:.5rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--band-rule);white-space:nowrap}.ds-board tbody tr:last-child{animation:ds-arrive 1.6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite}@keyframes ds-arrive{from{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--band-ink) 22%,transparent)}}

narrative.overview:
The page is a wayfinding sign system. Every feature is a sign: a flat enamel plate with an ink legend strip on top and a plain field below, identified by a square pictogram, standing on a concrete ground. An ink overhead band carries the wordmark and the language gates. Picking a gate changes every sign at once; that instant switch is what the page exists to show.

Density is calm and legible, not compact. Type does the work: one hyperlegible signage face at heavy weights for legends and figures, its mono sibling for everything a developer would type (codes, bytes, API calls). Color is nearly absent: blue-grey ink, warm concrete, and a single signal yellow that only ever means "you are here".

The world rejects the library-landing default: no gradient hero, no feature-card grid with shadows, no syntax-highlighted code blocks.
keyCharacteristics: Flat enamel plates: ink legend strip over a plain field, 4px corners, no border, no shadow.
One accent, one meaning: signal yellow marks the active locale and nothing else.
Signage face for words, mono sibling for code, bytes and calls.
Line state carries meaning: dashed means "not here yet", solid means "here".
Direction is logical: arrows and layout mirror in right-to-left scripts.

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow means the active locale. Do not use it for buttons, highlights, success states, badges or decoration. A second yellow element breaks the sign system.

rules.name: The Ink-Only Rule
rules.body: Everything that is not the active locale is ink, faded ink or concrete. New states are expressed with line style, weight or inversion, not new hues.

rules.name: The Literal-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: If a developer would type it (an API call, a key, a filename, a byte count, a locale code), it is set in the mono cut and marked `dir="ltr"`. Everything a traveller reads is in the sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Numbers that change or align (counter, readouts, board) use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Enamel Rule
rules.body: Plates are flat: no shadow, no border, no hover lift. If a surface needs separation, change its tone or add a hairline.

dos: Do build every new feature as a Sign: pictogram plus title in the legend strip, a sample sentence, a detail, and the call that produced it.
Do draw any new pictogram on the 24 by 24 grid with one 1.9 stroke and round caps, in `currentColor`; mirror it in RTL if it points.
Do use dashed strokes for absent or not-yet-loaded states and solid for present ones.
Do set every literal (calls, keys, filenames, bytes, codes) in the mono cut with `dir="ltr"`.
Do use logical properties so layout mirrors in Arabic, and test in dark appearance.
Do keep transitions to color properties at 140 to 160ms ease-out, and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't use signal yellow for anything but the active locale.
Don't add shadows, borders or hover lifts to plates.
Don't add a gradient hero, a feature-card grid, or syntax-highlighted code blocks.
Don't apply letter-spacing to Arabic text.
Don't introduce icon fonts or glyph icons; pictograms are authored SVG.
